meta.source: kaleem-digital-solution repo, src/styles/global.css (pastel sketch system v1, Sept 2026), as live on kaleem.dev

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background: cream paper with the pencil-speck texture (`.paper`). Every content section sits on paper or on one pastel.

tokens.name: paper-2
tokens.usage: A deeper paper for a contrasting band (the Work section, values grid), ruled top and bottom with a 2px `ink` line.

tokens.name: gray
tokens.usage: Warm neutral fill for a button that must stand apart from paper but carry no service meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The pen. All headings and body copy, every 2px outline and the sketch shadow line. 10.8:1 or more on paper and on every pastel.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Lead paragraphs under the hero, eyebrows, stat labels, captions. 5.8:1 or more on paper and every pastel.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in running text on `paper` only (4.9:1). On `paper-2` and pastel bands, links are `ink`, weight 600, underlined with a 6px offset.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Inline link hover and pressed state (5.7:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on paper and pastels: 2px solid, 2px offset. On the board, use `sky` instead.

tokens.name: board
tokens.usage: The night sky: header and footer ONLY, with the WebGL starfield (`data-sky`) painted over it. Also the chrome bar of a WindowWidget and the rail of a PhoneFrame.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Text, and the logo's box and name, on `board` (13.7:1).

tokens.name: chalk-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `board`: footer body, nav links at rest (10.2:1).

tokens.name: chalk-dim
tokens.usage: Footer column labels and the smallest text on `board` (7.4:1).

tokens.name: board-line
tokens.usage: Rules inside the footer. Decorative only (2.2:1): never a control border.

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: The Jailbreak (system liberation), our signature service. Also the key at the end of the five-step track.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Websites & web apps. On `board` it is the focus ring and the wordmark tint (11.4:1).

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Mobile apps. Also the hero band of Home and About, and the X badges of the 'Stuck with…' list.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Management & store systems. Also the primary call-to-action fill ('Book a free audit' in the hero).

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: Networks & security (cameras, Wi-Fi, access control).

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Consulting & training. Also the header CTA button and the 'Everything stays yours' band.

tokens.name: logo-block
tokens.usage: Logo yellow: the one block leaving the box in the logo mark. Never used for anything else (no text, no fills, no buttons).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Form success text on paper (6.8:1). Not defined on the site yet: carried over for forms. Always with a word ('Received', «تم الاستلام»).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form error text on paper (6.1:1). Carried over for forms. Always with a word and an icon, never colour alone.

families.arabic: "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", "IBM Plex Sans", Tahoma, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline. 44px on mobile. Arabic: Amiri (`serif-ar`) 700, no letter-spacing, line-height 1.22.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Inline band titles and sub-sections. 24px on mobile.

styles.name: step-end
styles.usage: The last stop of the five-step track (the key).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: We get your data out of old, locked systems and rebuild it on modern tech that you own.
styles.usage: The hero paragraph, in `ink-muted`, max 520px wide. 18px / 30px on mobile.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We moved the center off a broken legacy WordPress site onto a modern platform it fully owns.
styles.usage: Case-study summaries next to a screenshot.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every project ends the same way: your data, code and accounts in your name.
styles.usage: Default body copy and article prose (62ch max). Arabic: IBM Plex Sans Arabic, line-height 1.9.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels and 'more →' links. 14px in the compact size.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Android and iOS, published in your name.
styles.usage: One-line descriptions inside cards; step labels (600).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows above a heading, in `ink-muted`, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat labels, figure captions, small print.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Proof numbers in case studies. 24px on mobile. Wrap in <bdi> on Arabic pages.

styles.name: step-number
styles.usage: Numbers inside the 50px circles of the five-step track.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Mono meta labels and section numbers in article pages, uppercase. Arabic swaps to IBM Plex Sans Arabic 12px, no caps, no tracking.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The logotype only, always lowercase. Never for headings.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Hairline nudges, icon offsets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside compact buttons; between dots in a window chrome bar.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap; gap between lines in a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Child rhythm inside a sketch card; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between hero buttons; between stacked text blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; heading-to-body gap.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Sketch-card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between hero columns and between blocks in a section.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Gap between text and screenshot in a case row; section padding on mobile (56px in practice).

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero bottom padding.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags, the step-track circles and the X badges.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Inner top corners of a window chrome bar so the starfield fits flush inside the sketch outline.

sketch.note: The hand-drawn outline: an uneven 2px ink border and a second pen line offset down-right. Radii are deliberately unequal per corner.

tokens.name: sketch-line
tokens.usage: Every outline: cards, buttons, windows, section rules.

tokens.name: sketch-offset
tokens.usage: Distance of the second pen line under a card.

tokens.name: sketch-radius
tokens.usage: Cards, windows, service tiles, value cards.

tokens.name: sketch-radius-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons.

shadow.note: Not a blur: a solid offset copy of the outline, cut from the paper. Hover lifts the element up-left 4px and grows the offset.

tokens.name: shadow-sketch
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-sketch-lift
tokens.usage: Clickable cards on hover and focus, with translate(-4px, -4px).

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Elevated buttons (.skb) at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-button-lift
tokens.usage: Elevated buttons on hover and focus, with translate(-4px, -4px).

tokens.name: shadow-flat-lift
tokens.usage: Flat buttons (.fbtn) on hover: a soft drop appears from nothing.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width.

tokens.name: gutter-desktop
tokens.usage: Side padding of the page container on desktop.

tokens.name: gutter-mobile
tokens.usage: Side padding below 672px.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons; 40px in the compact size.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: The night-sky header; anchors clear it.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Below this: hero stacks, cards go 2 across, case rows stack.

tokens.name: breakpoint-mobile
tokens.usage: Below this: 1 column, the step track turns vertical, buttons go full width.
